{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column for non-numeric values
print("Revenue sample:", sales_df['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Check for any non-numeric values
non_numeric = sales_df[~sales_df['revenue'].str.match(r'^\d+\.\d+$')]['revenue'].unique()
print("Non-numeric revenue values:", non_numeric)

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for NaNs after conversion
print("Number of NaNs in revenue after conversion:", sales_df['revenue_numeric'].isna().sum())

# Now filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue, excluding NaNs
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Print result
mean_revenue"}
